import sys

class AntiPalindrome:
    def process(self, br, pw):
        N = int(br.readline())
        freq = [0] * 26
        moves = 0
        sLine = br.readline().strip()
        sChars = list(sLine)
        costStrings = br.readline().split()
        costs = list(map(int, costStrings))
        totalCost = sum(costs)
        for i in range(N // 2):
            if sChars[i] == sChars[N - i - 1]:
                freq[ord(sChars[i]) - ord('a')] += 1
                moves += 1
                totalCost -= min(costs[i], costs[N - i - 1])
        for ch in range(26):
            if freq[ch] > moves / 2:
                excess = freq[ch] * 2 - moves
                positions = []
                for j in range(N // 2):
                    if sChars[j] != sChars[N - j - 1]:
                        if (ord(sChars[j]) - ord('a') != ch) and (ord(sChars[N - j - 1]) - ord('a') != ch):
                            positions.append(min(costs[j], costs[N - j - 1]))
                positions.sort()
                for j in range(min(excess, len(positions))):
                    totalCost -= positions[j]
        pw.write(str(totalCost) + "\n")

def main():
    br = sys.stdin
    pw = sys.stdout
    ap = AntiPalindrome()
    ap.process(br, pw)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
